recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit FamilyMemberHistory negation only if unresolved cross-resource absence work such as FHIR-38899 reaches a final decision that changes the current precoordinated-code/text pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-17887 was a Published FHIR-core Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for negative family-history examples. The accepted scope was one FamilyMemberHistory.condition.code example for No Known Problems or a negated condition such as No history of malignant tumor of breast for an individual family member; the broader No family history of heart disease request was left to Observation.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites GH#0b58425. Commit 0b584258d4f5ad42f6385524e2c02866ea6c878e added source/familymemberhistory/familymemberhistory-example-negation.xml with SNOMED CT code 700146008 and the No history of malignant tumor of breast text, and added the example to the then-current FamilyMemberHistory example machinery.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to Patient Care. Current source still includes the negation example, lists it in list-FamilyMemberHistory-examples.xml, and says FamilyMemberHistory.condition.code can capture No Known Problems or negated conditions for one family member. Earlier FHIR-8782 established the same guidance, and later FHIR-43306 was Resolved - No Change after explicitly referencing the FHIR-17887 example and recommending a precoordinated condition.code, or CodeableConcept.text if no code exists. Broader FHIR-38899 remains Triaged and does not override this applied decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. The current source already satisfies the seed issue, and adding a separate negation indicator or duplicate prose would be inconsistent with later Patient Care guidance.

related_jiras.note: Implemented in the same 0b584258d4 commit but concerned a separate FamilyMemberHistory notes heading, so it was not independently decided here.
